_readme: THE COPILOT CAGE, AS DATA. Claude Code is caged by a settings file that
names the denied tools. GitHub Copilot CLI has no such file - it takes
the denial on the COMMAND LINE, so the cage here is a list of arguments
UNVERIFIED, AND SAID SO ON PURPOSE. Copilot CLI was not installed on the
machine that wrote this, so these flags were taken from GitHub's
documentation and never run. They are DATA precisely so you can correct
them without touching code: edit this file, relaunch, done.
HOW TO CHECK, in one command: run `copilot --help` and compare. If a
flag below is not listed there, it is wrong, and a wrong deny flag is
worse than none because it reads as protection that is not there.
CONTRACT RULE 1 IS WHAT THIS ENFORCES: everything the agent does runs
through the se lane. If the flags do not hold, the cage is ADVISORY on
this host - the agent is asked rather than prevented. Know that before
